texts.zh: 星海共同体的官员注意到[Root.GetName]境内有缇扬奇存在。由于缇扬奇害兽管制议案已经生效，这使得我国处于违反星系法状态，直至这些生物被消灭或是自行主动离开为止。
texts.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have observed the presence of Tiyanki within the borders of the [Root.GetName]. With the Tiyanki Pest Control resolution having been enacted, this leaves us in Breach of Galactic Law until the creatures are euthanized or leave our space of their own accord.

label.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
label.en: This infestation must be dealt with.
